lines.t: I am… the I AM
The voice before the dawn
The breath within the silence
The ever-living One
I am your God, ever near, never far
Emmanuel, the light in the dark
Your righteousness, your anointed King
The Savior, the One over everything
Holy One, exalted high
Ancient light that never dies
The One who was and is to be
Endless power, eternity
I am the Kingdom, I am the flame
I am the power that remains
I am the glory, ever the same
Call on My name…
Call on My name
I am the life, the source, the breath
I hold the keys to life and death
I am the light that breaks the night
I am…
The I AM
Maker of all, the unseen frame
Holding together all that remains
The breath of life within your soul
The living path that makes you whole
The Lamb who stood, the price was paid
Love poured out, the debt erased
Risen first, alive again
Breaking the silence, defeating the end
I am the Kingdom, I am the flame
I am the power that remains
I am the glory, ever the same
Call on My name…
Call on My name
I am the life, the source, the breath
I hold the keys to life and death
I am the light that breaks the night
I am…
The I AM
Before you were…
I loved you still…
Through Me you live, by My will
Your Father, shield, your steady hand
The beginning and the end
The voice inside, the quiet call
The truth that rises over all
The seed, the harvest, the living stream
The bread of heaven, your unseen dream
The risen star, the morning bright
Fulfillment written into light
The sacred law, the final aim
All things restored in My name
The judge who sees the heart within
The cornerstone you stand upon
The shepherd calling, “Come and see”
The door into eternity
I am the Kingdom, I am the flame
I am the power that remains
I am the glory, ever the same
Call on My name…
Call on My name
I am the life, the source, the breath
I hold the keys to life and death
I am the light that breaks the night
I am…
The I AM
King of kings, forever reign
Lord of all, beyond all names
The first, the last, the endless call
The meaning, the center, the all in all
The way, the truth, the life you seek
The voice that lifts the low and weak
I am with you, you in Me
Endless love, eternally
I am…
The I AM
